packageRules.description: The exam runs Kubernetes 1.35: only patch releases of the kind node image
The Python emitter stays on 3.13 with Alpine
A major release can change commands and output on the pages: a person reviews it
These releases bring images that versions.env pins by hand (no renovate comment): a person sets them before merging

prBodyNotes: This pull request changes `versions.env`. The `sync-versions` workflow then commits the matching course files to this branch, and the `labs` workflow tests every lab and playground.
Minor and patch updates merge on their own when every check is green, including `sync` and `all environments pass`. Major updates, kube-prometheus-stack and Argo CD wait for a person:
- [ ] For kube-prometheus-stack or Argo CD: set the values without a `# renovate:` comment in `versions.env` to the images the new release runs.
- [ ] Run the playground commands on the pages and replace any command output that changed.
